  @media (max-width: 640px) {

<script>document.body.classList.add('pc-landing-page');</script>

<section class="pc-landing">
  <img src="myprofile.jpg" alt="Daniel Redel" class="pc-avatar" />
  <p class="pc-greeting">Hey, I'm Daniel 👋</p>
  <h1 class="pc-name">Daniel Redel</h1>
  <p class="pc-subtitle">Economist &amp; Data Scientist &middot; Causal Inference &middot; Berlin</p>
  <p class="pc-pitch">Applied causal inference for competition policy, pricing, and tech.</p>

  <form class="pc-input-wrap" id="pc-hero-form" autocomplete="off">
    <input type="text" class="pc-input" id="pc-hero-input"
           placeholder="Ask me anything about Daniel's work…"
           aria-label="Ask about Daniel" />
    <button class="pc-send" type="submit" id="pc-hero-send" aria-label="Send">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
        <line x1="5" y1="12" x2="19" y2="12"></line>
        <polyline points="12 5 19 12 12 19"></polyline>
      </svg>
    </button>
  </form>

  <p class="pc-chips-lead">Or try:</p>
  <div class="pc-chips" id="pc-hero-chips">
    <button class="pc-chip" data-q="Tell me about Daniel's background and experience."><span class="pc-chip-icon">🙋</span> Me</button>
    <button class="pc-chip" data-q="What projects has Daniel shipped?"><span class="pc-chip-icon">💼</span> Projects</button>
    <button class="pc-chip" data-q="What research and publications does Daniel have?"><span class="pc-chip-icon">📚</span> Research</button>
    <button class="pc-chip" data-q="What are Daniel's technical skills and methods?"><span class="pc-chip-icon">🛠️</span> Skills</button>
    <button class="pc-chip" data-q="What blog posts has Daniel written on causal inference?"><span class="pc-chip-icon">✍️</span> Blog</button>
  </div>

  <p class="pc-escape">Prefer to browse? <a href="myposts.html">Blog</a> · <a href="projects.html">Projects</a> · <a href="research.html">Research</a> · <a href="about.html">About</a></p>

  <div class="pc-convo" id="pc-hero-convo" aria-live="polite"></div>

  <button class="pc-reset" id="pc-hero-reset" style="display:none;">Start a new conversation</button>

<script>
(function () {
  // Production backend (Railway). Override for local dev by setting
  // window.CHATBOT_API_URL = 'http://localhost:8000' before this script runs.
  var API_URL = (window.CHATBOT_API_URL || 'https://web-production-df6e66.up.railway.app') + '/api/chat';

  var form   = document.getElementById('pc-hero-form');
  var input  = document.getElementById('pc-hero-input');
  var send   = document.getElementById('pc-hero-send');
  var chips  = document.getElementById('pc-hero-chips');
  var convo  = document.getElementById('pc-hero-convo');
  var reset  = document.getElementById('pc-hero-reset');

  var busy = false;

  function escapeHtml(s) {
    return s.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
  }
  function renderInline(s) {
    s = s.replace(/\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)\s]+)\)/g, function (_m, t, u) {
      return '<a href="' + u + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">' + t + '</a>';
    });
    s = s.replace(/\*\*([^*\n]+)\*\*/g, '<strong>$1</strong>');
    s = s.replace(/(^|[^*])\*([^*\n]+)\*/g, '$1<em>$2</em>');
    return s;
  }
  function mdToHtml(raw) {
    var safe = escapeHtml(raw || '');
    var blocks = safe.split(/\n\s*\n/);
    var out = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < blocks.length; i++) {
      var block = blocks[i].replace(/^\n+|\n+$/g, '');
      if (!block) continue;
      var lines = block.split('\n');
      var isList = lines.length > 0 && lines.every(function (l) { return /^\s*-\s+/.test(l); });
      if (isList) {
        var items = lines.map(function (l) {
          return '<li>' + renderInline(l.replace(/^\s*-\s+/, '')) + '</li>';
        }).join('');
        out.push('<ul>' + items + '</ul>');
      } else {
        out.push('<p>' + renderInline(block).replace(/\n/g, '<br>') + '</p>');
      }
    }
    return out.join('');
  }

  function addMessage(role, text) {
    var el = document.createElement('div');
    el.className = 'pc-msg pc-msg-' + role;
    if (role === 'bot') el.innerHTML = mdToHtml(text);
    else el.textContent = text;
    convo.appendChild(el);
    convo.classList.add('pc-open');
    el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
    return el;
  }
  function addTyping() {
    var el = document.createElement('div');
    el.className = 'pc-typing';
    el.innerHTML = '<span></span><span></span><span></span>';
    convo.appendChild(el);
    convo.classList.add('pc-open');
    el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
    return el;
  }

  async function submit(question) {
    if (busy || !question.trim()) return;
    busy = true; send.disabled = true;
    addMessage('user', question);
    var typing = addTyping();
    reset.style.display = 'inline-block';

    var botEl = null, botText = '';
    try {
      var resp = await fetch(API_URL, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ question: question })
      });
      if (!resp.ok || !resp.body) {
        typing.remove();
        addMessage('bot', resp.status === 429
          ? 'Rate limit reached — please wait a minute and try again.'
          : 'Something went wrong. Try again, or reach Daniel via [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/daniel-redel-14b052b6/).');
        return;
      }
      var reader = resp.body.getReader();
      var decoder = new TextDecoder();
      var buf = '';
      while (true) {
        var c = await reader.read();
        if (c.done) break;
        buf += decoder.decode(c.value, { stream: true });
        var parts = buf.split('\n\n');
        buf = parts.pop();
        for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
          var line = parts[i].trim();
          if (!line.startsWith('data:')) continue;
          var payload;
          try { payload = JSON.parse(line.slice(5).trim()); } catch (_) { continue; }
          if (payload.type === 'token') {
            if (!botEl) { typing.remove(); botEl = addMessage('bot', ''); }
            botText += payload.text;
            botEl.innerHTML = mdToHtml(botText);
            botEl.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
          } else if (payload.type === 'done') {
            if (!botEl) { typing.remove(); addMessage('bot', 'No answer returned.'); }
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      typing.remove();
      addMessage('bot', 'Connection error. Is the backend running? (Dev: start `uvicorn app.main:app --reload` in the portfolio-chatbot-api repo.)');
    } finally {
      busy = false; send.disabled = false; input.focus();
    }
  }

  form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    var q = input.value;
    input.value = '';
    submit(q);
  });

  chips.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var btn = e.target.closest('.pc-chip');
    if (!btn) return;
    submit(btn.dataset.q);
  });

  reset.addEventListener('click', function () {
    convo.innerHTML = '';
    convo.classList.remove('pc-open');
    reset.style.display = 'none';
    input.value = '';
    input.focus();
  });
})();
</script>
